label: base
desc: Check frame time at the Kokiri spawn and on the walk with default settings

label: async-skip
desc: Check frame time when draws without a built pipeline are skipped (Switch 2 draws: Skip)

label: pipeline-wait-2
desc: Check frame time with the per-frame pipeline wait budget at 2 ms instead of 8

label: pipeline-wait-16
desc: Check frame time with the per-frame pipeline wait budget at 16 ms instead of 8

label: pacing-60
desc: Check frame time with Frame Pacing Mode fixed at 60 instead of Auto

label: fence-immediate
desc: Check frame time with GPU Fence Behavior Immediate

label: fence-balanced
desc: Check frame time with GPU Fence Behavior Balanced

label: fence-accurate
desc: Check frame time with GPU Fence Behavior Accurate

label: dma-unsafe
desc: Check frame time with DMA accuracy Unsafe

label: dma-safe
desc: Check frame time with DMA accuracy Safe

label: sync-memory
desc: Check frame time with Sync Memory Operations on

label: precache-always
desc: Check boot time and frame time with shaders precached before the game starts

label: no-reactive-flush
desc: Check frame time with reactive flushing off

label: no-barrier-feedback
desc: Check frame time with barrier feedback loops off

label: astc-cpu
desc: Check frame time with ASTC textures decoded on the CPU instead of the GPU

label: aniso-16x
desc: Check frame time with anisotropic filtering forced to 16x

label: vram-aggressive
desc: Check frame time with VRAM usage mode Aggressive

label: no-async-present
desc: Check frame time with asynchronous presentation off

label: no-async-shaders
desc: Check frame time with asynchronous shader building off

label: no-vertex-dynstate
desc: Check frame time with vertex input dynamic state off

label: cpu-unsafe
desc: Check frame time with CPU accuracy Unsafe
